| Fellow activist,

We’re on the brink of losing our next generation of voters in the Commonwealth. According to the Department of State, more than 1.7 million Pennsylvanians — of all ages — who are eligible to vote aren’t registered at this very moment. Far too many are disengaged from the political process, which puts our democracy in peril.

Our youth find access to the ballot even more challenging. The 26th Amendment granted 18-year-olds the right to vote, but far too many are disillusioned about politics, skeptical of elected officials, and navigating turbulent times. It is an institutional failure on the part of so many.

**[Fellow activist, here at the New Pennsylvania Project, we’re hard at work trying to fix that. Can you donate today to help us continue our important work and save the next generation of voters?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45509483/346267123/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220519YouthVote_N_KK_90DO_8_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1YjdjNDJmLWExZDctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LsRUO6wo_srOqvRwDdygoJ5yQ4LUuIMMwE76KlfysMM=)**
[DONATE NOW](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45509484/346267124/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220519YouthVote_N_KK_90DO_8_NG_N_B1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImM1YjdjNDJmLWExZDctZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4YzMyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LsRUO6wo_srOqvRwDdygoJ5yQ4LUuIMMwE76KlfysMM=) The youth are our future — and maybe, with some help, they can be our present. **Pennsylvania’s 2020 presidential election was decided by less than 35,000 votes. Without the edge of 150,000 young voters, it would have gone very differently.**

Now, for the 2022 elections, research ranks Pennsylvania’s youth vote as the most significant in the nation. But the same research shows we need to invest in uplifting them for that to happen.

**Right now, we’re failing at that.** According to a January 2022 research report from The Civics Center, **less than one-in-four** 18-year-olds who are eligible to vote are actually registered to vote in time for the 2022 midterm elections.

This may only be true because older folks have apparently deemed civic education a lower priority than banning books or pushing a CRT boogeyman narrative on the misinformed. When we provide voting-age students with the information they need to help make their lives and the lives of their family members better, we’ll see an energized young electorate.

**[Fellow activist, it’s critical we ensure that the youth make it to the polls every election to build power in their communities and join the electorate. clean_body: | | Hi there, it’s Mark Begich, former U.S. Senator from Alaska. I’m endorsing Chris Constant for Congress because I know he’s the right choice to represent all of Alaska. For the first time in nearly 50 years, Alaskans have an opportunity to send a progressive to the U.S. House of Representatives. But to realize this historic opportunity we must consolidate the Democratic base behind our strongest candidate. That candidate is Chris Constant. = | | = My endorsement for Chris is based on more than two decades of working together both as an elected official and as a business owner. I have seen firsthand his passion for public service and his unrelenting commitment to the issues that matter in our community. Chris is proud to stand as an Alaska Democrat. He is unafraid of holding others accountable and I believe he will be the backstop we need to protect Alaska values. = Thank you for joining me in supporting Chris in the upcoming June 11 Special Election Primary! Mark Begich | = | | ** Paid for by Constant for Congress Constant for Congress P.O. Box 240361 Anchorage, AK 99524 United States

| | Friends, I've truly been impressed by how many people have shown a passionate interest in our campaign. We are very grateful to all the help that we've had with putting up large signs, distributing our literature, volunteering to work polls on election day, and spreading the word about the campaign to their family, friends, and neighbors.
We still need more help with labor to put up some of our large signs (4 foot by 8 foot) around the district, as well as volunteers to distribute literature on election day, June 7th. If you have signed up to volunteer on our website, and have not been contacted, expect to be no later than tomorrow. If you have not yet gotten a bumper sticker or yard sign, we'll be in contact as well by tomorrow to get one to you.
Please follow us at www.facebook.com/MichaelCassidy4Congress and on Twitter @VoteCassidy, where we'll have updates (as well as on the website) for upcoming events. Sincerely, Michael

body:
These leaders are moving Illinois forward.
#
Peter,
Each election, we pay a lot of attention to the names at the top of the ballot.
Today, I want to tell you about a few folks who may be a bit further down the list – but whose work is just as important when it comes to moving Illinois forward.
We have impressive Democratic champions working in our state government, like Treasurer Mike Frerichs, Comptroller Susana Mendoza, and Attorney General Kwame Raoul.
Remember these names, Peter. These elected officials do the work that is critical to building the future we all want to see.
I am confident in our Democratic candidates, but with the GOP elites going “all in” to defeat our Democratic ticket – and billionaires like Ken Griffin already dropping north of $25 million to support Illinois Republicans this cycle – we can’t take anything for granted this November.
**Let’s show the GOP that we mean business. I’m setting a $10,000 flash fundraising goal to help re-elect Illinois Democrats Susana Mendoza, Kwame Raoul, and Mike Frerichs.**

name: Laurie Teper
subject: THANK YOU!!
body:
Hi Team Geels!

TOGETHER OUR HARD WORK PAID OFF!

Thank you to all the volunteers who have stepped up and helped out in some way, shape or form. We door knocked, made phone calls, put signs out, helped out at events, hosted meet and greets, worked at the polls during early voting and Election Day, donated money, coordinated volunteers and PRAYED. Time is valuable and we appreciated your willingness to sacrifice it for the Geels Campaign. I hope you were encouraged and excited to be involved! I know I met a lot of like minded citizens that I may have never met if it wasn't for getting involved.

It takes a lot of people with time and energy behind the scenes to help the candidate win and we have our work cut out for us in the months ahead. If you can stay on the team and help in any way, please do! We need people to stay involved if we want to reclaim our country!

For now, take a break, rest up and we will gear up for November soon! Look for an email from Courtney this evening.

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
__
__
With Heartfelt Gratitude,
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Coordinator
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04
Email: [volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com](mailto:volunteers@courtneygeelsforcongress.com)
Cell: (847)212-5651
[courtneygeelsforcongress.com](http://courtneygeelsforcongress.com)

body:
Peter,
Working Families Party just announced that they’ve decided to endorse Rep. Donald Payne Jr. in the NJ-10 primary.
Here’s the thing, Peter: The WFP in New Jersey has steered their car off the progressive turnpike of NJ and are heading straight to K Street in Washington with lightning speed.
And despite their consistent claims that we need to abolish New Jersey’s corrupt ballot line, they consistently support candidates like Donald Payne Jr. who benefit from the line, the machine, and the corruption endemic to our state.
So, it’s not surprising that they’ve chosen to endorse a machine-backed candidate, even though that candidate doesn’t align with their stated “values.”
Rep. Payne Jr. and NJWFP have that in common: they’re both willing to compromise their values and bend the knee to a corrupt political machine that stalls progress and hurts New Jersey families.
Luckily, there’s another option. Meanwhile, Rep. Donald Payne Jr. has accepted contributions from anti-union corporate PACs, including Amazon. name: =?utf-8?Q?Courtney=20Geels?=
subject: Team Courtney Wins the Primary
body:
Now the real work starts! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fd80e7741498/team-courtney-wins-the-primary?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
---
| | Dear Peter,
---
|
---
| We've won the primary! I am humbled by all the work of our volunteers, and the trust you, the voters, have placed in me to press forward in the general election. I couldn't have done any of this without all of you canvasing, knocking on doors, attending events, etc.

Now the real work starts. My opponent in the 2022 election will be Democratic candidate Valerie Foushee. I don't know her, but she appears to be someone who is passionate about serving our community, and I look forward to interacting with her on the campaign trail. She was "the establishment candidate" in the Democratic primary, if by establishment they mean someone who is for the Green New Deal, Medicare for All, Cancelling Student Loan Debt, and Raising Taxes on Small Businesses. I am 100% for her right to support these things, though I firmly disagree with all of them.

---
|
---
Courtney Geels will face Valerie Foushee for the NC-4 congressional seat in 2022.
| But what is best for North Carolinians? We are dealing with record inflation and are at the cusp of an economic recession because the Fed (Federal Reserve Board) is playing catch-up on raising interest rates. Is the solution to increase our country's debt, make already-expensive groceries and other goods MORE expensive through taxing businesses, increase the cost of healthcare with our inflated and less valuable dollars through universalizing it in Medicare for All, or increase the price of fuel for our cars and homes by passing draconian measures in the Green New Deal?
---
|
---
| This isn't personal. It's about what's best for all humans who live here in our beautiful state. It's about our kids of ALL ages; it's about caring for our elders and retirees who've already paid their dues and shouldn't have to pay the inflation tax; it's about our workers and our business owners. We thrive not through throwing money at things, but by taking responsibility and pursuing that which is better. That's what this campaign is about.

Thanks again. We need you even more now, because we can't do it without you.
---

name: John Fetterman
subject: re: your first contribution since our announcement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Our first 24 to 72 hours of fundraising will be crucial in determining the kind of campaign we can run, so today is an important day to donate if you can swing it.
#
Derek,
Late Tuesday night, I came to you to let you know that we're *officially* the Democratic nominee for Senate in PA.
Now, I'm reaching out to you again because this is so important:
[**Will you contribute $5 to my campaign? Our first 24 to 72 hours of fundraising will mean so much to determine the kind of campaign we can run, so today is an important day to donate if you can swing it. 🙏**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220519-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220519-5900&refcode2=5900_434096_5TR7FV&akid=5900%2E434096%2E5TR7FV)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220519-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220519-5900&refcode2=5900_434096_5TR7FV&akid=5900%2E434096%2E5TR7FV)**
Look, this journey isn't going to be easy by any means. In fact, this is already THE most expensive Senate race of 2022 -- _and the primary ended less than 48 hours ago._
Like I said this morning, the campaign we build together is gonna be special and it’s gonna be BIG. Together, we are going to run a truly grassroots campaign that fights for each and every vote across all of Pennsylvania's 67 counties.
**But I can't accomplish any of this on my own, so I hope you'll join me in this fight by contributing whatever you can today.**
**[Derek, can you donate $5 or anything you can to our campaign for Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220519-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220519-5900&refcode2=5900_434096_5TR7FV&akid=5900%2E434096%2E5TR7FV)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220519-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220519-5900&refcode2=5900_434096_5TR7FV&akid=5900%2E434096%2E5TR7FV)**
**What we raise in these first three days will set the tone for the rest of this race.** Every bit of support that comes in today + tomorrow will go a long way in building the kind of campaign we can be proud of — and one that can win.
I'm so unbelievably grateful for everything you have done + will do to help us flip this seat, Derek.
Glad you're here,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220519-5900-footer&t=1&refcode2=5900_434096_5TR7FV&akid=5900%2E434096%2E5TR7FV)**

| | |
# American Strength, Unity and Purpose
Only 2 days before Virginia 10 Republicans go to the polls in the Firehouse Primary. I can't thank you enough for your prayers and support over these past months as we've ran this race with purpose across the district.

We have met 1000s of people who are ready to take America back to founding principles of Life, Liberty and the Pursuit of Happiness. Democrats have once again overreached and deliberately targeted parents just advocating for better schools and education for their children. Democrats have discriminated against our healthcare workers and military members for holding religious views that run counter to their radical agenda. They can't even define what a woman is and continue to push their gender non-sense on our schools and in U.S. companies. It's time to fight and it's time for change.

Together, let's take America back and NEVER again allow Democrats to be in charge of our government and its institutions. The great awakening starts this Saturday and will culminate in a victory November 8th, when Republicans take back the House of Representatives and hold the Biden Administration accountable for deliberately undermining of our laws, our elections and using the FBI, DHS, DOJ and other agencies to target Americans. Their days of corrupting OUR nation are over.

It's time for bold leaders to take on Washington and I look forward to your vote this Saturday! Make sure to call, text and email your friends...we have to show up in mass and make a loud statement that grassroots still matter, small business owners still matter, parents still matter and yes, America is still worth fighting for!

Our team has been sprinting the past few months and especially in the past week. We were canvassing in Warrenton, Bristow, Manassas, Leesburg the past few days, and we'll be in Landsdowne, River Creek and Ashburn neighborhoods on Friday for the final stretch.

Also this week, I attended the American Life and Liberty Candidate forum and answered questions ranging from election integrity to the economy to border security, and many more. Last evening, I conducted a Facebook live interview with the Vice Chair of the Fairfax Republican Committee for outreach which you can find it here: https://www.facebook.com/mentions/1652891256824805/?notif_id=1652891256824805&notif_t=mention&ref=notif. I am the only candidate in this race with the experience and expertise to represent our district on day 1!

God bless you and your families, and may God bless the United States of America! In Service,
John Henley

body:
We have our opponent: right-wing extremist Ted Budd.
#

Here’s what you need to know about Ted Budd now that he’s officially our opponent:
* He’s a Trump loyalist who has been in lock-step with the far-right wing of his party, including when he pushed the Big Lie and voted to overturn the election on January 6. That’s why he was one of Trump’s first endorsements of the cycle.

name: Diehl for Governor
subject: Even The Boston Globe admits the "numbers don't lie"
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DIEHL FOR MASSACHUSETTS
body:
| | | |
---
Dear Delegate,
When even The Boston Globe starts talking about it being a good year for Republicans, you know we must be on to something!
That's what Globe columnist Joan Vennochi concluded in [her most recent column](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ITbXPkCS6x1ljJnQSuuClUwaeqcMz0k81lbRc8NO8LDMINPI2YE8TO0DfDLUgB5gQBa3RPB_n-BYpf5Rr85bxiHF-1_3p1WOyBYqppYt6elWESwDacMX17Ox-cI2mp0eaxccnRYSk7lY3h1WaoqTvdzW9XZh_LvuFeckXB8JdbwuWbmvY-hAt7mE1BfcAFGtWPxF2LXFOh7754jO8djV7e8Qdkn0rXdNK43A1IDPmjs=&c=v_43uD42aP-cKOogkaELwyerbvOBLDUCgZLnqhDU6AZXqOurvpy_ow==&ch=GcJZ42bQYLjcbS3kW00ljBYPi-tVZYTFe2Mhu6XIiM24lQhF5COObQ==) \-- Republicans have momentum and this is potentially shaping up to be a very bad election year for Democrats in Massachusetts.
According to Vennochi, Secretary of State Bill Galvin confirms my campaign has submitted 16,673 certified signatures to secure a spot on the ballot \-- far more than my Republican challenger, and compared to just 14,000 signatures for Maura Healey.
As Vennochi says in her column, "numbers don't lie."
Of course, this all comes on the heels of the last pre-convention poll, showing my campaign is leading my Republican challenger by a four-to-one margin amongst likely GOP primary voters.
The conclusion is clear. I am the only candidate capable of taking on Maura Healey and the progressives this fall, and we are going to win. The numbers prove it. And, we have you to thank for that.
For weeks, you traversed the state with us, collecting signatures at stores and shopping malls. Throughout the process, we had a chance to talk with voters about the problems we see in our state:

* We reject the Biden economy and its sky-high inflation, government spending, and taxes, at all levels of government.

* We will fight against unfair mandates that take away your rights and freedom.

body:
Peter,

I officially filed for reelection this week! Preparing for another election season has me thinking of some of our past runs for office.**I even dug up a little Throwback Thursday picture of me with my family back when I ran for state Senate in 2010:**
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/4RQ4eYBqeTnP-AassIbTTXDAgAxTv5oXuro2zUgF-Zs=/xI5m4DdumRGkjHYFc71-neBYiHg7Mj3c2-qiaVmKXZk=?refcode=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})
---

A few things have changed since then. My kids are so much bigger! My knees don't work quite as well.

But many things have stayed true. Every day that I serve, I have the opportunity to advocate for you. Every day that I serve, I get to work for a brighter future - not just for my kids but for kids and families throughout our region. And every day, friends like you have had my back. Many of you have been with me since the beginning, and I want to say thank you for your support.

Together, this people-powered team has come so far -- but with so much on the line this November, it's clear that our work is not over. The future of our democracy is on the ballot, which is why we have to keep looking forward.

If I've learned anything from campaigning over the years, it's that it's the strength of the grassroots team behind a candidate that makes all the difference. That's why today, I want to keep growing our campaign.

**[I'm counting on folks from this community to take action today to show you're with me in the work to defend the Democratic House majority. Will you chip in $10, $5, or whatever you can to help us build another winning campaign?](https://act.myngp.com/el/4RQ4eYBqeTnP-AassIbTTXDAgAxTv5oXuro2zUgF-Zs=/xI5m4DdumRGkjHYFc71-neBYiHg7Mj3c2-qiaVmKXZk=?refcode=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})**

Peter, I am in this line of work to serve the people, not special interests. It's important I see support from people across the region because this is a people-powered movement, through and through.

Right now, we're fighting to cut costs -- including gas prices -- for working families. We're fighting to improve our nation's supply chains and create more economic opportunity for more people in more places. We're fighting to defend Social Security and Medicare for our seniors. And we're fighting to defend voting rights and reproductive freedom, because future generations depend on it.

**[We have to keep up the momentum if we're going to win this year, and it starts with growing our grassroots team. Contribute whatever you can to our campaign today. ](https://act.myngp.com/el/4RQ4eYBqeTnP-AassIbTTXDAgAxTv5oXuro2zUgF-Zs=/xI5m4DdumRGkjHYFc71-neBYiHg7Mj3c2-qiaVmKXZk=?refcode=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220519_tbtfil_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})**

It's an honor to serve you,

Derek

Peter,The Radical Left wants you to believe that there were no issues in the 2020 election. Unlike some of my opponents, I know our election in 2020 was illegitimate - Steve Simon did not follow our laws and pushed radical liberal changes into our elections.Filmmaker Dinesh D’Souza’s documentary _2000 Mules_ follows a group called **True the Vote** , which purchased millions of dollars worth of data and used geo-tracking technology to expose more than 2,000 ballot traffickers across five battleground states: Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Georgia, Arizona, and Michigan.This Saturday, May 21st, I am hosting a viewing of _2000 Mules_ at the Jem Movie Theatre in Harmony**** because I believe voters deserve to see the new evidence that is being ignored by the liberal mainstream media. Peter, doors open at 6:15 PM on Saturday at the Jem Movie Theatre in Harmony for a viewing of _2000 Mules_. For more information, contact [**Kyle@JeremyMunson.com**](mailto:Kyle@JeremyMunson.com)
|

|

[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=8154a105ce&e=f4c2e54596)
|
---
Election integrity is single-handedly one of the most important issues Republicans face in the upcoming midterm elections. Many Americans have lost faith in our electoral process, and I believe voters deserve to know the truth. That is why we are screening _2000 Mules_. Every Republican in this race will tell you what they are going to do to fight for election integrity in the future. Let me tell you what I have done:
* I was one of 15 Minnesotans — and the only candidate in this race — who [**signed a letter to Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=cb55467970&e=f4c2e54596) asking for Minnesota to be included in his lawsuit with the United States Supreme Court.
* I also joined the [**letter from Arizona State Sen Wendy Rogers**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=320bed1812&e=f4c2e54596)**** calling to throw out all results where elections were deemed fraudulent.
* I was a founding member of the MN Election Integrity Team and filed a lawsuit with the MN Supreme Court to prevent Simon from certifying the 2020 election.
* I authored [**Voter ID, Provisional Balloting, and additional bills**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=ac2c265240&e=f4c2e54596) to strengthen our elections.
* I attended an [**Election Integrity Rally outside of the Minnesota State Capitol**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=e3f502b390&e=f4c2e54596) to show my support for President Donald J. Trump, where I was attacked by the mainstream media for standing with our President.

Some candidates are talking about what they have done since they entered this race two months ago. Well, as you can see, I have been fighting since Day One to defend President Trump and the integrity of our elections.
[](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=ccc1549c93&e=f4c2e54596)
**Excerpt of Letter on Hennepin County Data Practices Request**
I, along with three other colleagues in the conservative caucus, demanded access**** to data from all [**counties and cities that took CTCL Grants**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=955cb838a9&e=f4c2e54596) (Zuckerbucks) long ago. This money was used by local governments under contract with Zuckerberg's nonprofit to unconstitutionally increase voter turnout in key Democrat demographics. We turned this data over to our constitutional attorney, Erick Kaardahl, who worked for the Trump Administration on challenging the 2020 election results in numerous states.My conservative caucus has been on the forefront of fighting against election tampering for years. Rep. Steve Drazkowski acquired [**the now infamous Somali ballot harvesting videos**](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=07301f08b9&e=f4c2e54596) for Project Veritas and our caucus of conservative fighters detailed the many holes in Minnesota's election systems just weeks before the 2020 Presidential election.No surprise to you, they ignored it.Every other candidate in this race waited until a Congressional seat was available before they took a stand for our elections. As the Proven Conservative Fighter in this race, I have been in the trenches with you demanding answers since Day One.The American people deserve better. We deserve to know if our conservative voices were ignored two years ago. It is important for every American to be aware of what has been uncovered by _2000 Mules_ and, as an elected official, it is my responsibility to inform the people I represent.Join me on Saturday, May 21st, at the Jem Movie Theatre and, together, we can see why there is enough evidence to prove that over 2,000 ballot-traffickers delegitimized the results of the 2020 Presidential election.If you have any question, please email Kyle at [**Kyle@JeremyMunson.com**](mailto:Kyle@JeremyMunson.com) I look forward to seeing you this weekend, Peter.
Jeremy Munson
Candidate for Congress

| | Thought you should know... we won!

It's still sinking in, and it doesn't feel "real" yet but it is.

Because Tuesday night, Idahoans showed up to say NO MORE.

_No more indoctrinating our kids.

No more medical coercion with masks and vaccines.

No more playing games with our taxes._

Sadly, my former opponent and his pals are going around telling anyone who will listen that we launched a "smear campaign" and were "mean-spirited."

But nothing could be further from the truth.

Because I didn't attack _him_... I attacked _his politics_ (I actually think he's a nice guy).

At any rate, the Idaho Senate will look VERY different in 2023.

Because there will be a large number of conservatives present to FIGHT for Idahoans (we haven't had this for a long time).

And contrary to what the media is saying nationwide, this isn't a "far-right takeover." Twenty years ago my politics would be considered middle-right. But since the left has moved ULTRA FAR left, it makes guys like me (and most Idahoans) seem far-right when in reality... it's the left who moved, not us.

Because what's "extreme" about less taxes, stopping the sexualization of children, and being in control of what gets injected into our bodies?

What's extreme about saying NO to big government?

What's extreme about protecting life, liberty, and property?

The answer: _NOTHING._

This is old-school conservatism. The kind I was raised on.

Elon Musk recently tweeted this image (about himself) which captures the dynamic perfectly:

It's been a WILD few months...

**So thank you for all your support, help, donations... all of it.**

This wasn't a solo effort and it took a massive grassroots push. I'm convinced that great things are in store for Idaho. And I couldn't be more proud to represent Nampa in 2023.

Thanks for being a part of this,

**Brian**

name: Dr. Kathleen Harder
subject: Our movement lives on
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Kathleen Harder for Congress
body:
Hi Peter,

>From the soaring costs of prescription drugs, high medical costs that drive
people into debt, the shortage of mental health services, and a growing
homelessness crisis, we have so much work to do to build a healthier Oregon for
all.

I'm proud of the coalition that our campaign built. To the thousands of
individuals in Oregon that donated to our campaign, local elected officials
that endorsed our movement, and community members that spent countless hours
knocking on doors, all I can say is thank you for your commitment to a
healthier Oregon.

We did not win this race. But rather than commit ourselves to defeat, I would
like to call your attention to some of the things that we won.

We engaged new voters. We got people talking about the issues of healthcare
and climate change. We drove the conversation about ending corruption and
providing affordable housing. We may not have won this race, but politics is
not only about winning races.

Something bigger happens when someone chooses to get off the sidelines and
demand space be made for them in our democracy. Something more important than
victory happens when passionate people set out to talk to their neighbors about
the issues in their communities.

We built a movement, and today that movement did not elect me, but that does
not mean that it is not successful.

Congratulations to Andrea Salinas on her victory!

And one last time, I need to say thank you so much for all the work and effort
you put into building this movement. Please know that our fight for a healthier
Oregon with high-quality affordable health care for all, stronger schools, a
safer planet, and a lower cost of living has only just begun.

–Dr. Harder

#
Peter, we know that Senator Patty Murray has been a relentless champion for reproductive rights ever since she first got elected. The Washington Post recently profiled her leadership in the fight to protect reproductive rights for women everywhere. Read why the _Washington Post_ called Senator Murray, “the single most effective Democratic combatant against Republican attempts to restrict abortion and otherwise roll back reproductive health-care rights on Capitol Hill."
Check out key excerpts from the article below—**[then pitch in $5 toward Patty Murray’s $25,000 filing goal.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45513087/346284558/-625208437?refcode=pm_em_220519_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjBlY2FjOC1hZWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hCXD7BCPDu5VPNav2g-SrAlBpq3pxjHUTwsHlt6k2kE=)**
At a time when McConnell and other Republicans have stated that a national abortion ban is on the horizon should they take power, this election is more important than ever—the stakes are real. Not only do we desperately need every single pro-choice voice we can send to the Senate—we need Senator Murray's unshakeable leadership in this fight.
****[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45513088/346284559/-625208437?refcode=pm_em_220519_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjBlY2FjOC1hZWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hCXD7BCPDu5VPNav2g-SrAlBpq3pxjHUTwsHlt6k2kE=)****
**After decades defending abortion rights, Patty Murray readies for offense **
by Mike DeBonis for the Washington Post
_Moments before the Senate took a doomed vote on abortion rights Wednesday, it fell to Sen. Patty Murray — the highest-ranking Democratic woman and the party’s preeminent leader on health care — to sound a rallying cry against those seeking to reverse Roe v. Wade._
_“To everyone who is scared, everyone who is furious, know this: They have some big roadblocks in their way — me, Senate Democrats, House Democrats, and millions of patients across this country who are going to stand up and speak out,” she said._
_The speech sparked applause from spectators inside the chamber, who included dozens of House Democratic women who had marched across the Capitol to protest Roe’s potential end at the hands of a conservative Supreme Court — a possibility that was rendered stark this month by the leak of a draft opinion summarily overturning the constitutional right to abortion._
_It was an unusually high-profile moment for Murray, 71, but far from an unfamiliar one._
_For well over a decade, the no-nonsense Washington lawmaker has been the single most effective Democratic combatant against Republican attempts to restrict abortion and otherwise roll back reproductive health-care rights on Capitol Hill. It’s a battle she has sought out since she was left aghast by the Supreme Court confirmation hearings for Justice Clarence Thomas in 1991, during which he was accused of workplace sexual harassment that he denied. Murray was elected the next year in the “Year of the Woman” — which brought the total number of female senators from two to six._
_There are now 24 women in the Senate, and especially among the 16 Democrats, Murray has long since emerged as a leader, mentor and outspoken voice on women’s rights. And in the wake of the Supreme Court leak, she has been front-and-center for Democrats, flanking Senate Majority Leader Charles E. Schumer (D-N.Y.) in front of cameras while, behind the scenes, helming a crash effort to formulate a strategic response to the coming final Supreme Court decision._
_“She doesn’t believe in leaving half our population behind on any issue,” Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) said of Murray. “She reminds us over and over that we are not going back, ever.”_
****[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45513089/346284560/-625208437?refcode=pm_em_220519_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjBlY2FjOC1hZWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hCXD7BCPDu5VPNav2g-SrAlBpq3pxjHUTwsHlt6k2kE=)****
_Much of that work, however, has taken place out of plain sight on Capitol Hill, in conference rooms and committee suites where the final details of must-pass legislation is hammered out. Murray, who chairs the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee as well as the Appropriations subcommittee on health, is the lawmaker who is routinely tasked with negotiating the final deal — and the final deal, she vividly describes, almost always involves abortion or women’s rights._
_Some of the episodes get public attention — such as in 2011, when President Barack Obama and Senate Majority Leader Harry M. Reid (D-Nev.) were preparing to cut a budget deal with congressional Republicans that would snatch federal funding away from Planned Parenthood. Murray was called to Reid’s office late at night during a rainstorm to bless the deal._
_“I look around, and I’m the only woman in the room and he says: ‘We have one last decision to make, and we just wanted to make sure you were okay with it,’ ” she recalled. “I said, no way in hell.” Murray rallied Democratic women against the move and, ultimately, the deal was cut with the Planned Parenthood funding intact, though Obama agreed instead to a provision banning local taxpayer funding for abortions in D.C._
****[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45513090/346284561/-625208437?refcode=pm_em_220519_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjBlY2FjOC1hZWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hCXD7BCPDu5VPNav2g-SrAlBpq3pxjHUTwsHlt6k2kE=)****
_Murray is confident that her long record on women’s issues — which starts with abortion rights but also includes advocacy for child care, education funding and much more — will be a centerpiece of her campaign pitch. Smiley’s campaign did not respond to emails seeking comment on Murray or on her own abortion positions. Smiley declined to comment to local news outlets this month on the substance of the leaked Supreme Court opinion, though she has made previous public statements describing herself as “100 percent pro-life.”_
_Asked about Smiley, Murray said, “Every single person up for election will have to answer this question. This is not an answer where you can say it’s settled law. It’s clearly very not settled right now.”_
_But in the months until election season gears up in earnest, Murray said she is focused on developing a comprehensive strategy that can both spark a public outcry while also using whatever levers of power Democrats now possess to protect abortion rights. In the interview, she said she is contemplating hearings that would elucidate the effects of the end of Roe on American women and discussing legislation that could include guaranteeing the rights of military members to pursue in vitro fertilization to preventing states from tracking phone data of women who go out of state to seek abortions._
_“I was just a mom sitting at home in 1992 when all of a sudden it became real to me,” she said, adding that most American women “don’t know how real it is yet because it hasn’t been finalized. It hasn’t been put in their laps except in states like Texas and Oklahoma. But this is not a moment for people to go, ‘Oh, gee whiz, that happened,’ because it won’t change unless you stand up. ... My role is to make that happen._
****[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45513091/346284562/-625208437?refcode=pm_em_220519_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZjBlY2FjOC1hZWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=hCXD7BCPDu5VPNav2g-SrAlBpq3pxjHUTwsHlt6k2kE=)****

In the interview, she said she is contemplating hearings that would elucidate the effects of the end of Roe on American women and discussing legislation that could include guaranteeing the rights of military members to pursue in vitro fertilization to preventing states from tracking phone data of women who go out of state to seek abortions. “I was just a mom sitting at home in 1992 when all of a sudden it became real to me,” she said, adding that most American women “don’t know how real it is yet because it hasn’t been finalized. It hasn’t been put in their laps except in states like Texas and Oklahoma. But this is not a moment for people to go, ‘Oh, gee whiz, that happened,’ because it won’t change unless you stand up. ... My role is to make that happen. = As Washington's senior U.S. Senator, Patty Murray is working to help families, solve problems, and defend our progressive values._ PAID FOR BY PEOPLE FOR PATTY MURRAY

While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil

| Peter,

My name is Jeremy Hunt.

I’m a former U.S. Army Intelligence Officer, a father, husband, and graduate of West Point.

I’m a native Georgian and a loyal patriot.

I’m also a proud, principled and outspoken Black conservative.

Peter, **I was deployed and spent 2016 in Ukraine training their armed forces on how to respond to external threats to their sovereign territory**.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9933147b75ba41adaf875268bc04a493&_e=ODDUgSktE9dvlXoSgeBKkh5ZWIt7o3wTJzy4f_LkVJCFl9Om5hTK5FClVjOELBiUIR0x-Jgm5eOCbKusD6p7Zyh5iUFZixfE0CISccw0HZWJeCahVNSz4y7SEYY83ZVV36BcY85WUVsD8QDWEhBMq47E962iE7rK1DyhE4krLIFgqKY5gnh_LTQuWVR0tC083w2lcFpW_6Z6Kl5TL1XyxlsAzKP88Jhw8RpLFrwJ8j8yz1a67iHaoVmfCQyMiTH_0xIdQtF508vC7ZXwTdU21u8WIuOJyW6yujk4-66XHLpcmv8yTD7pNvDyuCxZzGJE1GorLU4cHMC-PN1EnwHGP4oCG4skex24MZXScqAG5XJ4vsw4z_jMY2CcOiqtQqbfgTzKmcAqvCYx0RJVC8D7pqoQWf2RRghzZUnBCDyaUxZRk52d93R8oI6hlDEcpl1XQxVMfJGjgEQnN4A0WUeTmY_WfCxFMUSGgRy3yG593MyK0XrrzNrn4VM-Smrkanma)

Now, I’m running for Congress in Georgia’s 2nd congressional district to be a voice in Congress advocating for a strong and robust military. Right now, the number of veterans serving in the House is dwindling by the year, and quite honestly, that’s dangerous.

Oh - and the district in which I’m running? Yea, **it hasn’t been held by a Republican since 1875.** But now the tides have finally turned and I know I’m the man to get the job done.

**If you’re interested, please continue reading for just a few more moments.** If you don’t have the time right now to continue reading, then **[I hope you don’t find it too presumptive of me to ask for a small donation to my congressional campaign today](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9933147b75ba41adaf875268bc04a493&_e=ODDUgSktE9dvlXoSgeBKkh5ZWIt7o3wTJzy4f_LkVJCFl9Om5hTK5FClVjOELBiUIR0x-Jgm5eOCbKusD6p7Zyh5iUFZixfE0CISccw0HZWJeCahVNSz4y7SEYY83ZVV36BcY85WUVsD8QDWEhBMq47E962iE7rK1DyhE4krLIFgqKY5gnh_LTQuWVR0tC083w2lcFpW_6Z6Kl5TL1XyxlsAzKP88Jhw8RpLFrwJ8j8yz1a67iHaoVmfCQyMiTH_0xIdQtF508vC7ZXwTdU21hmo8igea_AL8AWVTP2tUseK0nvQh6kTq7K6OJv_0cODLqy7vwvnu2Me3oBP_5vlL3pxVG5TlT8K2_1EMeTtAjLfmvYJAMkJHBMq1JoTZB2Aar4vWaBZfHzhAOpvQIcoVBTV0Wx9TihXFvr_599Csf_vE3JOmMtDRXknz-2caHEwxw4iiWNtDioZ8qu53uXlfikWoj5Zn-HwQv3qRNZ6CeIH9dm5y05Pxl1C8KmS3sHZ)**. We need real leaders in Congress – people who actually know how to do the job from day one, not people who yell at news cameras for attention. I care deeply about our country and I want to make this nation better for my family and yours.

**[I can flip this district Republican for the first time since 1875, but only if I have the resources. If you can, please chip in $5, $10, or even $15 right now. I don’t want this opportunity to go to waste](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9933147b75ba41adaf875268bc04a493&_e=ODDUgSktE9dvlXoSgeBKkh5ZWIt7o3wTJzy4f_LkVJCFl9Om5hTK5FClVjOELBiUIR0x-Jgm5eOCbKusD6p7Zyh5iUFZixfE0CISccw0HZWJeCahVNSz4y7SEYY83ZVV36BcY85WUVsD8QDWEhBMq47E962iE7rK1DyhE4krLIFgqKY5gnh_LTQuWVR0tC083w2lcFpW_6Z6Kl5TL1XyxlsAzKP88Jhw8RpLFrwJ8j8yz1a67iHaoVmfCQyMiTH_0xIdQtF508vC7ZXwTdU21mKjTV9GsU2N-k8DMK3Zzq_IlPgT8u1vfOnQy1HVOKr8NAM27lyVl1ToM_1z__hO8UGue3wSOzr-ij9F-xQ4thRyevr832wL1vtiBQx4GA-0U4GfMBxBjdY1xQAtILq3Ed0BZ9Y8dkYK4BQ-J1cNMgNjtaTP7HkF7CjCc7eXHoLsEx_1j5UmuLZUizEr2v2blxpdrThj2oy0AUoTLRS02G5hG22mzySiQIhIl0Q36zas)**.

[ CHIP IN TO HELP ME MAKE HISTORY »](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9933147b75ba41adaf875268bc04a493&_e=ODDUgSktE9dvlXoSgeBKkh5ZWIt7o3wTJzy4f_LkVJCFl9Om5hTK5FClVjOELBiUIR0x-Jgm5eOCbKusD6p7Zyh5iUFZixfE0CISccw0HZWJeCahVNSz4y7SEYY83ZVV36BcY85WUVsD8QDWEhBMq47E962iE7rK1DyhE4krLIFgqKY5gnh_LTQuWVR0tC083w2lcFpW_6Z6Kl5TL1XyxlsAzKP88Jhw8RpLFrwJ8j8yz1a67iHaoVmfCQyMiTH_0xIdQtF508vC7ZXwTdU21jO-PY7E4QiouqDgKJsE8-yUH2s3cG0-5VWRfXnt1ZsET_sxZlwJMWzBf8xVB6djlpwf0I-c0zuAcl9G7P5IH4VmiViCWonc-gIk29SUe_xZF7RSiHibnYq4ctfWYqthlnMh1Itks7jTiBUb_BihZMvff5ZUKfPUEXzHjWg0aQa4U589JiRFvE_VREDj5S80GiEH4F1IHehyyHB63tOQgtPzg7LT548Ofk3shu66ojzl)
We need serious leadership back in Washington, D.C. We don’t need leaders who take weeks and months to make decisions as important as whether to support democracies like Ukraine.

For all of his bluster, Joe Biden is solely responsible for having to shut down not one but TWO American embassies in less than a year. This leadership isn’t leadership at all - it’s an embarrassment. **While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil dictators like Vladimir Putin.**

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9933147b75ba41adaf875268bc04a493&_e=ODDUgSktE9dvlXoSgeBKkh5ZWIt7o3wTJzy4f_LkVJCFl9Om5hTK5FClVjOELBiUIR0x-Jgm5eOCbKusD6p7Zyh5iUFZixfE0CISccw0HZWJeCahVNSz4y7SEYY83ZVV36BcY85WUVsD8QDWEhBMq47E962iE7rK1DyhE4krLIFgqKY5gnh_LTQuWVR0tC083w2lcFpW_6Z6Kl5TL1XyxlsAzKP88Jhw8RpLFrwJ8j8yz1a67iHaoVmfCQyMiTH_0xIdQtF508vC7ZXwTdU21mVMCFWR-Db71WfDGiAopza98OxH0D0CuyRABz_Ftte3nOQcsl870rdXVpDVezxj3caax4-vQpQ0gKO_bK14UYmksQP00FxqKuWN6-DhEKsnQaNZHTqjpBw9vnHdtSCj9-PLtDkto0z5hfMpomYOzvc9RY_WoIu2o436nY3fWxFnqiw8RZpXxXrFmzJlTgCwYNTBoqQj7Ci0muDDllSNc1lSZ-Xcj6H0XgAYKVK01bkU)

Like Joe Biden, my Democrat opponent has been in Washington for far too long; he’s lost touch with our district.

As an Army veteran who spent time on the ground in Ukraine, I can tell you, the warning signs that an invasion was imminent were there for years. **Joe Biden was slow to react and we’re now in a major debacle**.

body:
He is enabling the attack on women rights | | | |
---
|
---
| | | **Dear Peter,**

Our current representative in Congress, David Trone, is one of the wealthiest members of Congress and a self-described “Democrat” who has proudly donated more than [$150,000 to anti-choice and anti-democracy Republicans](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=4b8cce723b&e=0faa9de128), including TX Governor Greg Abbott, TX Lt. Gov Ken Paxton, AZ Gov Doug Ducy, and NC U.S. Senator Thom Tillis – leaders of the modern-day attack on Roe v. Wade and voting rights.

**Our member of Congress helped enable this attack on women rights and reproductive freedom!**

I want to get your input on this, but first I need to ask:

**Can you chip in $25, $100, or anything you can today to help me defeat Rep. Trone? The primary is two months from today!! [Click here to donate via ActBlue!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=8840ce3649&e=0faa9de128)**
---
| The way I see it – and tell me if you agree with me here – the only way we can end pay-to-play politics in Washington is to get people like David Trone out of Congress. He proudly said, [“I sign my checks to buy access.”](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=36f9ea09f8&e=0faa9de128) And sign checks he has – [over one thousand](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=8af528a1b7&e=0faa9de128) of them – including to anti-choice, Republican extremists.

And frankly, his questionable donations aside, I just don’t think someone still running an expanding, multi-billion dollar business can avoid major conflicts of interest while supposedly serving the people of Maryland in Congress.

Even worse, just last month, and repeatedly in the last year, Congressman Trone listed his current employer as Total Wine when making donations to candidates. **Even Mr. Trone appears confused about who he is supposed to represent.**

Don’t get me wrong – I don’t blame anyone for making a living or being successful – but serving in Congress is more than a full time job and should always be about the people who sent you there.

When I founded the Disaster Accountability Project in 2007, I did it to ensure accountability, effectiveness, and transparency in disaster relief and humanitarian aid in the wake of Hurricane Katrina. People were hurting, and they needed help.

**Well, people are hurting today, too. Western Maryland has been hurting for a long time.** While Rep. Trone is writing checks to buy influence to advance his own multi-billion dollar business, families and small businesses are reeling from the devastating effects of pandemic – including rampant inflation. Our climate is changing in ways we can actually see at a local level. And somehow – in the richest nation on the planet – healthcare is still not guaranteed to every person. So many people in our district are struggling to get by.

People are hurting, but David Trone is more focused on building his own wealth and access than serving the people of Maryland.

**I am running for Congress because I believe we can do better.** And that’s why I want you involved in this campaign – the only way we win is if you’re with me.

And so, my question to you is: how do you feel that your Member of Congress prioritized “buying access” by writing massive checks, including to anti-choice and anti-democracy Republicans? [Let me know what you think here.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=9ab539bc10&e=0faa9de128)

Thanks for your input here. I’m looking forward to reading your responses.

And again, campaigns are expensive and I’m up against someone who is both willing and able to buy elections – someone who has written checks for $25 million to massively outspend his past opponents. **[Anything you can spare will mean the world to me.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=53bff69e4f&e=0faa9de128)**

We are in this together.

Sincerely,
Ben

name: Tom Fitton
subject: Our caseload is at an all-time high
body:
Judicial Watch just announced a major victory for cleaner elections! We settled our federal lawsuit against North Carolina after the state removed over 430,000 ineligible names from its voter rolls!

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch continues to exert a powerful impact against public corruption and unlawful government secrecy.
**_Not a week goes by when our investigators and attorneys aren’t unearthing documents corrupt politicians don’t want us...or the American people...to see_.**
**_And hardly a day goes by when we are not in court leading the all-important battles to protect the rule of law!_**
But our caseload is at an all-time high, and [we urgently need you to join with us](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58937&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=), so that we can stay on track with _all_ our work!
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58937&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

You may know from seeing me and my colleagues on television and radio and from getting my emails that right now Judicial Watch is breaking important ground on critical fronts:

* Our lawsuits compelling states to follow federal law requiring they clean their voter rolls (and help prevent voter fraud) are notching important victories for clean elections. We now have active lawsuits in **Colorado, Illinois** and **Pennsylvania..** and more are coming.

* Our **Biden Accountability Project** team continues to uncover incriminating information through Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) _lawsuits_ against U.S. government agencies for records related to serious allegations _and evidence of**Hunter/Joe Biden** corruption and influence-peddling in Ukraine, China and elsewhere_. Our most recent lawsuit against the U.S. State Department about **Hunter Biden** seeks to reveal more secrets about Biden family corruption.

* Our lawsuits are exposing the spread of **Critical Race Theory (CRT)** in our public schools and other public institutions**...** even at the U.S. Military Academy at West Point!

* And a September trial date has been set for the first of our civil rights lawsuits fighting for the First Amendment rights of teachers fired from their jobs just because they dared to criticize CRT and other extremist programs in their school systems.

We haven't yet written the final chapters on our litigation on these and other important matters, and we have a long road ahead of us... _and none of these or other victories on behalf of the rule of law would be possible without the support we receive from our loyal members across the country_. Not one.

[And that’s why I ask you to join with us and make a special gift to Judicial Watch today.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58937&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58937&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=)
---

Because as it stands right now...I feel _we cannot do enough_. You see, fighting isn't our endgame..._winning_ is what we do best.

[Your gift will help us win and stay on track](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=58937&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnM=) with _all_ of our investigations and lawsuits. And it will allow us to take on new challenges to the rule of law when they arise.

That's why your commitment _now_ is so __important__ - and will be - __deeply__ appreciated! Because you can take pride in knowing that your Judicial Watch has never fought harder for conservatives...and for the rule of law.

Please stand proudly with us today!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: URGENT: Stop Them From Spending Surplus
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=1)
---
Peter \-- The Minnesota Swamp has struck a deal to spend YOUR Surplus money! **Remember, they overtaxed us by $12 Billion - which equates to over $4,000 per taxpayer. GIVE IT BACK!** But the cries to Give It Back have fallen on deaf ears. Senate Majority Leader Jeremy Miller (Big RINO) is leading the charge to spend YOUR surplus money. He just struck a deal with Tim Walz and the Democrat House "Leaders." [](https://www.action4liberty.com/republican_senate_sells_out_spending_majority_of_surplus?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=2) Democrats got nearly everything they asked for out of this deal, including $1 Billion for teacher’s unions, $1 Billion for more health and human services spending, and $1.5 Billion for legislators’ pet projects. **If your legislators pass this legislation, Government would GROW and you would get almost none of your money back!** Any Republican who votes for this legislation will obliterate the narrative that they were ever for fiscal responsibility. This cannot stand. Remember, if legislators had returned the $12 Billion dollar surplus, you would receive a check back for $4,000! I don't know about you, but with Biden's gas prices climbing everyday, my family could use that money back in our pockets. Action 4 Liberty will be mobilizing grassroots conservatives to pressure their legislators to vote against surplus spending **It all starts with you. Contact your State Senator and State Representative NOW, and demand that they vote against this big spending scheme to appease the Left.** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=sXXfCgrOgKb9G_MAOfSoeydXsGz92cVrFhOOGKxAVM6_YCm43WSS4uZsz0eMdEnx&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=3 "CONTACT MY LEGISLATOR") [CONTACT MY LEGISLATOR](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=sXXfCgrOgKb9G_MAOfSoeydXsGz92cVrFhOOGKxAVM6_YCm43WSS4uZsz0eMdEnx&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=3)
---
With just days left until the end of the legislative session, you and I cannot afford to waste time.
Look no further than our past pressure campaigns. With your help last year, my team successfully pressured legislators to end Governor Walz’ “Emergency” that shut down churches, businesses, and schools.
My team knocked on doors in vulnerable DFL legislative districts, telling their constituents that these cronies defended Walz and his emergency powers.
## **Our Pressure Campaigns Work.**
With such a short time to go, I cannot guarantee that we’ll stop this reckless spending unfortunately. Perhaps that’s why these cronies waited to the last days to sell out on us.

But it’s our money and they OWE it to us!
What I can guarantee, however, is that these legislators will pay a price for wasting your tax dollars.

Holding politicians accountable is what my team does best. With your help, we’ll put the St. Paul Swamp back in their place.
Let’s remind them that they work for us. It's time to GIVE IT BACK!
**Sample Script 1**
**Hi, I have concerns about the reckless spending deal proposed by legislative leaders. We do not need to funnel more money into education, healthcare, or your special projects. Vote against spending any more spending and give back our surplus money now!**
***Wait for Response***
**These programs are already well funded, and while tax cuts are appreciated, they do not return the _current_ surplus to the people. Give the money back now!**
**Sample Script 2**
**As a constituent from your district, I demand an explanation for your support for spending surplus tax dollars on wasteful government programs. With rising gas prices, inflation, and food shortages, there is no question that this money deserves to be given back to us taxpayers. Give it back now!**
***Wait for Response***
**These programs are already well funded, and while tax cuts are appreciated, they do not return the _current_ surplus to the people. Give the money back now!**
Thank you in advance for contacting your state senator and state representative. We can't let these guys keep getting away with stealing our money.
**Jake Duesenberg**
**President, Action 4 Liberty**
[](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=4 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=stop_them_spending_surplus&n=4)

name: Peter Welch
subject: Governing over gridlock
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
It’s crucial we keep the Senate out of Mitch McConnell’s hands, and that’s exactly why I’m fighting for this seat.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=422%2E61531%2E5pi17G)
Hello,
From the Vermont Senate to the U.S. House, I’ve always been able to work across the aisle to deliver results for the people I’ve represented. I’ve always been able to find common ground by listening more than I talk—by focusing on solutions more than who gets the credit.
And it’s still possible today. Just a few months ago, we got over 100 House Republicans to support the Postal Service Reform Act. I’m running this race to represent Vermont’s problem-solving spirit in the Senate.
**But if Mitch McConnell takes back control, he’ll put progress out of reach.** He’s one Republican who doesn’t know the meaning of the phrase “common ground”—it’s his way or the highway. He’s blocked—or tried to block—COVID relief, common-sense gun safety, affordable childcare, voting rights, and the list goes on. He’s chosen gridlock over governing.
It’s crucial that we keep the Senate majority out of the hands of Mitch McConnell. I’m fighting to keep this seat blue so we can protect our imperiled democracy and deliver for Vermont families from Day One.
[**Please consider donating $5 or anything you can to help defend our Democratic Senate majority. Election season is heating up already, and we need to grow this grassroots team if we’re going to win.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2734?t=3&akid=422%2E61531%2E5pi17G)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

---
| [OTHER](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2734?t=13&akid=422%2E61531%2E5pi17G)
---

---
The Senate is split 50-50 right now—just one seat could be all the difference in the quality of life for hundreds of millions of Americans, from climate change to prescription drug costs and everything in between. And national Republicans have put Vermont on their radar as a target for November.
Unlike Mitch McConnell and the Senate Republicans, I’ve chosen governing over gridlock my entire career. I’ve brought home real results, and I’d be honored to keep working for Vermonters as a U.S. senator. But first, we’ve got to win this race.
[**Let’s keep this seat blue and protect our Senate majority. Can you donate $5 to help power this team to victory?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/2734?t=7&akid=422%2E61531%2E5pi17G)
Thanks so much,
Peter

body:
Don’t force explicit sexual education on elementary school students. | |
---
| | [ ](https://Turnredmedia.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=621b2e320db082dad48a1a39c&id=6f7618bf8d&e=ae0ea222da)
---
|

Friend,

When I came to the New Jersey State Senate, I promised to truly listen to the people I represent. Understandably so, many parents are deeply concerned about what’s going into their children’s education.

I wanted to take a few moments to tell you more about the legislation _I just introduced to protect parents’ rights_. First and foremost, **the bill’s sole purpose is to ensure parents have a say in what is being taught to their children under the age of 18**.

It is unconscionable to think that kindergarten through sixth-grade teachers would be forced to provide instruction on sexual orientation or gender identity. Could you imagine being a special needs teacher under this curriculum? Children are learning how to read and tie their shoes – who really thinks it’s right to force them to conceptualize explicit sexual education?

These are still conversations reserved for the kitchen table for when the time is right, just as they were in my home with my three children.

Instead of putting a deceptive name on a bill to radicalize the masses and cause chaos, let’s zoom in and take a look at the facts.

_Get back to basics – let kids be kids_.

Thank you,

[](https://Turnredmedia.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=621b2e320db082dad48a1a39c&id=ac41c09e58&e=ae0ea222da)
Senator Ed Durr
New Jersey’s 3rd District

Peter, Dr. Caraveo’s far-right opponent, Lori Saine, has been baselessly attacking Dr. Caraveo, but that’s not the worst of it. What’s more appalling is Saine’s anti-science, anti-choice, anti-democratic platform. Westword just named Lori Saine “the nastiest, most clueless politician” in Colorado, and her record proves why:
* Saine wants to**take away women’s right to choose.** She sponsored legislation to make abortion a felony, has suggested she wants to ban IVF and birth control, and cheered on SCOTUS’s leaked decision to overturn Roe.
* Saine **opposed efforts to lower costs** for Colorado families — she voted against child tax credits, capping the price of insulin, and ensuring there are protections for out-of-network medical bills.
* Saine is an **opponent of LGBTQ rights:** she opposed civil unions before same-sex marriage was legalized, and even now is using her platform to mock queer children.

Peter, this GOP extremism does not represent CD-8. The people of Adams, Larimer, and Weld County deserve better. That’s why this race is so important. Five days ago Chris experienced light-headedness and acute neck pain while giving a speech. He completed his remarks, drove nearly 3 hours back home, and then sought medical attention — finding out hours later that he had suffered a ‘benign’ venous tear (technically a minor stroke) at the base of his head/neck area.

Our family is so very thankful that he is currently on the way to full recovery and that his doctors are confident there will be no long term effects from this incident.

We deeply appreciate all the well-wishes, messages, and outpouring of love that he has received from so many Marylanders and others.

[**Thank you for all of your caring and concerned words. It means a great deal to Chris to hear from friends and supporters - you can click here to sign a Get Well card for him.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45514779/346292159/-1450784331?refcode=em220519getwell&refcode2=a98b3ad7-b5d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&contactdata=9CPLu8tVunZtFXuM0cAM%2Fk%2FnsZHC1GZT58iZ46uGFU0W%2BXZXSP50I%2BfG2KD1zQn2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOThiM2FkNy1iNWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kjtcCiNjXj6G8iTI_g3VzevD-R4UfGKGvjm4sYSxkbI=&emci=aff1b9c2-aed7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=a98b3ad7-b5d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=2216363)

As we were sitting in the emergency room at George Washington University Hospital Saturday evening, the horrendous news came in about the racially motivated massacre in Buffalo. Pure evil, Chris called it.

In August it will be 5 years since Donald Trump, as President, gave a nod to white supremacists at the "Unite the Right" rally in Charlottesville — calling them “good people”.

Sometimes you hear folks frustrated with the state of our country say things like "it doesn't matter who you vote for". Well, they couldn't be more wrong. Having leaders who stand up for our values matters — and it matters a lot.

That’s what motivated Chris to get engaged in politics in the first place, and it’s what drives him to work from dawn to dark every day. Knowing that you are in this together with him makes all the difference.

Thank you for your support and appreciation of Chris, my husband, and the work that he does. And thank you for your commitment to the fight for progress and a better future.

Sincerely,

Katherine Van Hollen

body:

Dinesh D’Souza’s movie about the 2020 election, _2000 Mules_ , will be playing this weekend in theaters around the country, _**including some cities this evening.**_ You can find out where to watch it two ways.
1. Go to the [_2000 Mules website_ website](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) to use their search function to find a local theater. In the upper right-hand corner of their home page is a red button that says, “**Find a theater**.” Click on that button and a search box will pop up.
2. Call your local movie theaters or look online to see if they are showing it this weekend.

Other Ways to Watch:
* If your local theaters are not showing the film, you can always call them and request that they get it. If enough people call, it’s possible they would show it.
* You can also still stream the film from [salemnow.com](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) or on the Salem Now app.

This is a very important documentary, and if you are able to watch it locally this weekend, all the better! Make sure to let your friends know too! In liberty, Jenny Beth Martin

body:
Friend,
We want to share an excerpt of a New York Times guest essay by Barbara McQuade, the former U.S. Attorney for the Eastern District of Michigan. In the essay entitled, "The Most Pivotal Elections in 2022 Are Not the Ones You Think," McQuade writes: Jocelyn's re-election is crucial because she "literally wrote the book on the role secretaries of state play in protecting the democratic process."
-Team Benson
Here's the excerpt :
The fate of our democracy doesn’t hinge on the battle for the House or the fight for control of the Senate, but on state elections for a once sleepy office: secretary of state.
....The Democratic incumbent, Jocelyn Benson, will face Kristina Karamo, a community college instructor endorsed by Mr. Trump, this fall. Ms. Benson, a former election law professor, literally wrote the book on the role secretaries of state play in protecting the democratic process and resolutely withstood challenges to Michigan’s 2020 election.
Her opponent, on the other hand, has made debunked claims that she witnessed election fraud while observing poll workers in Detroit in 2020 and said that the Capitol riot was conducted by “antifa posing as Trump supporters.” Mr. Trump has been stumping for Ms. Karamo for a reason: “This is not just about 2022,” he said at a recent rally. “This is about making sure Michigan is not rigged and stolen again in 2024.”
Check out the full article here [https://www.nytimes.com/2022/05/12/opinion/midterms-state-races.html] .

clean_body: The results are in | Peter, We won! I’m thrilled to announce that WE WON the Republican Primary and that I am officially the Republican nominee to beat Chrissy Houlahan in November! I cannot express how thankful I am for each one of you. Thank you all for your continued confidence and support. This win belongs to all of us—those who attended events and displayed yard signs, those who voted, and those who worked on the campaign. I’m so grateful for each and every one of you. Let’s keep the momentum going—next stop, November 8th! I will need you now more than ever. I'll have more to share tomorrow, but for now, thank you–from the bottom of my heart. Guy PS. ,

The Republican Primary Election is THIS SATURDAY, May 21st from 9am-4pm.

Make sure you have a plan to vote, know where you're going, and bring your photo ID!

If you have any questions or need help finding your voting location, please call us at 571-484-4425 or email info@jeaninelawson.com

Thank you,

Jeanine

**_FIND YOUR MAY 21ST VOTING LOCATION_**
On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at [www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=67c8106f15&e=fc83fb200d)

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email [info@jeaninelawson.com](mailto:info@jeaninelawson.com) and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County: **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County: **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=ba0361a565&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.

name: Jeremey Hunt
subject: What I saw in Ukraine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by JEREMEY FOR GEORGIA
body:
While Joe and Hunter Biden were making money off Ukrainian gas companies, I was training Ukrainian military members how to defend themselves from evil

| Fellow Conservative,

My name is Jeremy Hunt.

I’m a former U.S. Army Intelligence Officer, a father, husband, and graduate of West Point.

I’m a native Georgian and a loyal patriot.

I’m also a proud, principled and outspoken Black conservative.

Fellow Conservative, **I was deployed and spent 2016 in Ukraine training their armed forces on how to respond to external threats to their sovereign territory**.

[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=dfaa35fb339b4423945368eb1d9027c5&_e=cMe_q9lcbNxth_559WLk5NWLr8sgsgwKcOKIhl6OfWehO4Yc-jXHkG3IWraiVvlT-AgOcEt0ltR56YapM-oJzZc1G7WPzs1kbX9XxblNCn7PZI1fgO8egJjCeCc-CUOnTAy-t0k2LUAw9BsjX8t_w76m8o7ObXU9wKj_04rt7RTpCe8R5ak_0U1JQt0qRWch9IwUNKUKuXInvMDPW8wCW0MhsbIOeh5_jgR5PJNCOJCMOdL69kpNfG-AMwrGFBynhnmX-4pLMHefUntQTPLuFcGr7MzC82i3x31XkwUI9erlQZSckfSG624GmXG2-Dx5WD13OrnMHyk6jSZTpPGArr4y7wU0gjqAUvZRwKSsc4-RKqMN7f6f6jHGaaAiQjCsfn93DNhQVf1jPV7YRUo-varTBeQQ6XBDla8g_aXdPSHX2wfCHkr-tBn0DBD4tJKg5bzBFGQz5sPgzflH28ZA04-kZu-5HJLxj3z4i3tYKCY%3D)

| | Doyle Canning here.

I want to start by thanking everyone in this movement.

Your hard work, sacrifices, contributions, and faith in our vision of progressive change, was met with a wall of billionaire Super PAC cash, and you did not cower. You did not turn your back on the promise of people-powered change. You took a stand because you know we can't wait, our climate can’t wait, change can’t wait - and together we kept on putting in the work.

Make no mistake, while this wasn’t the result we wanted, our movement is strong. We didn't win but if I had to do it all again, I would not hesitate. I am so grateful to each and every one of you.

Together, we promoted a positive vision for the future that prioritized bold action on climate, racial justice, and housing solutions.

Together, we raised over $250,000 from folks chipping in a couple of dollars at a time — with not a single cent coming from the fossil fuel industry, billionaires, or big corporate PACs.

Together, we showed the political establishment that a different kind of campaign was possible.

We may not have won this election, but our fight is not over.

The climate crisis is here, reproductive freedom is under attack, and — as we’ve seen in this election — corporations and billionaires spend big to make sure politics works for them.

I will have more to say on this later, but for now, know that our team will stay in the fight with you, no matter what.

Thank you for everything. Until our paths cross again, best wishes.

Sincerely,

Doyle Canning

## About Erik

---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

| | We did it, Peter! I’m so honored to have secured the Democratic nomination for NC-11. And I’m honored that we won all 15 counties across WNC. **From the bottom of my heart, thank you.** You have stepped up with us every step of the way for the past 14 months of campaigning and organizing everywhere. From knocking doors, to making calls, to digging deep to make another donation, you’ve shown us you are all in. With your help, we’ve proven yet again that a gay woman, Christian minister, and mom of three can win in the South, and although we’re celebrating and resting, the next phase of our work is now beginning. In a moment, I’m going to share what the next few months will look like for our campaign.**[But first, we need to kick off the general election in the strongest position possible so we’re counting on 2,000 Founding Donors to step up. Will you rush $25 or more to become one?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45509631/346267915/-2133212566?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_220519_FR_Victory_A0_na_U1_X2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGU4YjNiZC1hMWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Xr1zuVjK0RnAtDPsUcDCq-P-_Fu3GlLXYhTLWLiBJug=)** | | | [Become a Founding Donor](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45509633/346267918/-2133212566?refcode=EM_BS_JAS_220519_FR_Victory_A0_na_U1_X2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODg4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZGU4YjNiZC1hMWQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Xr1zuVjK0RnAtDPsUcDCq-P-_Fu3GlLXYhTLWLiBJug=)

The Republican primary was a very close call, **and we’re pleased to report that Madison Cawthorn _lost._**
I’ll be facing Republican State Senator Chuck Edwards in the general election. Edwards and Cawthorn have a lot in common when it comes to their politics – and their brand of extremism does not represent the values of WNC.
We have been planning for the general election since day one of our campaign. Now, our campaign to deliver real leadership to Western North Carolina enters a new phase, and we need to give it our all over these next few months. That starts with meeting every fundraising goal that we set from now until November.

Dear Friend, Thank you for all of your support to our campaign for the U.S. Congress. It’s greatly appreciated and be assured that you have made a difference.

**The only way to combat special interest influence is to have the support of generous individuals like you, who care deeply about restoring democracy.** Your generosity has fueled my effort to end “government for sale” and combat the damage being inflicted on our nation by Former President Trump’s friends, his allies in Congress and those who continue to support his extremist agenda. Since I entered the race, I have been humbled by the outpouring of support my candidacy has received. Because of friends like you, the campaign has gained great momentum. As I travel the district and spend time talking to voters it’s clear we need more leaders who will represent the interests of _**ALL**_ and not the special interests of a few.

Our democracy cannot flourish as more and more people choose not to participate, feeling they have no voice. My mission is to make all people feel that they have an equal voice and eliminate corruption eroding our system. Rest assured that I am doing everything I can to clean up politics as usual and bring needed change to our state and nation. **[Can you help me today, one more time, as we continue our march to Washington?
