Peter, The 2024 presidential election is going to be here before we know it, and our team wants to know who you think should be the Republican nominee. **Specifically — _Do you think President Trump should run again in 2024?_ Please take our brief survey now to let us know your thoughts!**
---
[**TAKE THE SURVEY >>**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/282e4263e04f74c17c94c760ea83e7c0/34143/1bebaa4a510466b3/b9158e77dcce4202c3d6b838967d376c/34143)

It's clear that America can't afford another four years with Joe Biden in the White House. Hey Peter, May is Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders Month. It means so much to me that our nation is collectively celebrating and acknowledging AAPI history, contributions, and culture.

**_Would you allow me to tell you a little bit about my very personal family story? I know most people don’t read long emails like this, but it would mean a lot to me if you read the whole thing._**

Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders make up a broad coalition of ethnicities and cultures with a deep history in this country.

I’ve been reflecting on the respective stories and experiences of my maternal and paternal grandparents, pictured below. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45519752/346311586/-1311403052?refcode=MTFC_20220519_EMPET_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOWE4YzU0Ny1jOGQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w_1tpYje9H6VN2KDRoYU3dLuzNmle_E7PTgKS3BllIA=&emci=de0315ba-99d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=39a8c547-c8d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=18839602) Painfully, along with my parents, they were all sent to Japanese‐American internment camps during World War II because of racist, fear‐mongering policies. They lost everything and had no choice but to rebuild their entire lives after the war.

**Our histories in this country have always been fraught. We continue to see an alarming rise in AAPI hate spurred by the COVID‐19 virus.**

Nonetheless, we’ve persevered. Our families have traveled across continents to pursue the American Dream and build a new, better life for their children.

Today, I’m feeling especially thankful for my parents, Nancy and Willie, for everything they sacrificed for me and my siblings. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45519753/346311587/-1311403052?refcode=MTFC_20220519_EMPET_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOWE4YzU0Ny1jOGQ3LWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiOGMzMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=w_1tpYje9H6VN2KDRoYU3dLuzNmle_E7PTgKS3BllIA=&emci=de0315ba-99d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&emdi=39a8c547-c8d7-ec11-b656-281878b8c32f&ceid=18839602) Peter, I think we can all agree: Asian Americans deserve to be treated with respect and dignity.

So, this AAPI Month, let’s take a stand against AAPI hate.

clean_body: Can I tell you a personal story? | = Hey Peter, May is Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders Month. It means so much to me that our nation is collectively celebrating and acknowledging AAPI history, contributions, and culture. Would you allow me to tell you a little bit about my very personal family story? I know most people don’t read long emails like this, but it would mean a lot to me if you read the whole thing. Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders make up a broad coalition of ethnicities and cultures with a deep history in this country. I’ve been reflecting on the respective stories and experiences of my maternal and paternal grandparents, pictured below. Painfully, along with my parents, they were all sent to Japanese‐American internment camps during World War II because of racist, fear‐mongering policies. They lost everything and had no choice but to rebuild their entire lives after the war. Our histories in this country have always been fraught. We continue to see an alarming rise in AAPI hate spurred by the COVID‐19 virus. Nonetheless, we’ve persevered. Our families have traveled across continents to pursue the American Dream and build a new, better life for their children. Today, I’m feeling especially thankful for my parents, Nancy and Willie, for everything they sacrificed for me and my siblings. Peter, I think we can all agree: Asian Americans deserve to be treated with respect and dignity. name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Less than 6 months to go
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220519&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220519&amount=28]
Team,
It’s hard to believe it, but we have just under 6 months to go until Election Day! Campaign season is about to get even more insane (hard to believe, I know) so today I thought I would take stock of where we find ourselves and what we can expect before November 8th!
To recap, I find myself in the most competitive House race in Michigan, and one of the most competitive in the entire country. After Michigan’s district lines were redrawn at the end of last year, I announced I would be running in Michigan’s new 7th district. It’s an area much larger than the district I currently represent, and it’s gotten much more rural – meaning I’ve been campaigning like I’m running for mayor in 30 small towns at once. I’ve been focused on engaging with new leaders and constituents in these small communities, learning about the issues that impact them most and what they are actually looking for in a representative.
We’ve talked about the need to address the cost of prescription drugs, bringing manufacturing back to places like Michigan so that our kids will be able to work for American companies, and preserving the clean water and air that is so fundamental to Michiganders' way of life.
I have two potential opponents currently running in the Republican primary. One is a State Senator and the other is running a self-funded campaign. In addition, outside groups looking to flip this seat are already heavily investing in this race. One group alone, the Congressional Leadership Fund, has already invested nearly $7 million in both television and online ads against me. That’s in addition to the millions spent last year.
That’s where we find ourselves today, so what’s next?
We’ll know for sure just who I’ll be running against after the August 2nd primary, but we do know that those ads I mentioned earlier are targeted at folks in the new areas of my district. That means some people I’m running to represent will have seen this stuff before I have the chance to meet them.
To compete, I’ll need to be strategic in two critical ways. First, I’m going to need to spend as much time as possible in the new areas of my district – visiting small businesses, walking in local parades, hosting coffee hours, knocking on doors, and anything that will let me actually introduce myself to the people who are about to see nasty things about me on their TVs. Unfortunately, it’s virtually impossible to meet everyone in these new areas, so the second part of my strategy will be purchasing my own advertisements to reach the folks that I won’t be able to meet in person.
There’s a secret third part to this strategy: contributions from grassroots supporters. Not only does purchasing advertisements and hitting the ground in MI-07 require significant resources, an outpouring of grassroots support may make some of these outside groups think twice about investing more money into a race that may not be as easy to flip as they once thought.
Which is why I’m asking if you would consider chipping in to support my campaign at this critical phase in the election. Anything you feel comfortable with really does help me be as strategic as possible for the next 6 months. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220519&amount=28]

body:
Dear Friends,

Everyone knows I consider Jared Moskowitz a close, personal friend, but many may not know why.

At the time that my beautiful daughter, Jaime, was shot at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School, my wife was protecting Jared’s young son, who was on lockdown in his preschool. My wife put Jared’s 4-year old son in a closet to keep him safe.

Jared’s speech on the Florida House floor three weeks later discussing that moment guaranteed the passage of historic gun violence prevention measures in Florida. Jared was there for me, my family, and the families of all of the victims.

His abilities to express true human empathy and to understand what matters most to those he serves is beyond most you will meet. And that’s exactly why he’ll make an incredible Congressman for our district.

I have full faith that Jared is the right person for the job. And I know that, with your support, he’ll continue to fight for important gun violence prevention policies in Congress. Can you donate $25 today to join the fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-march2022?refcode=311guttenberg]

The consensus is clear — Jared should be our next Congressman. He’ll lead this district with strength, decency, and civility. He’ll fight for things that matter to us and continue to honor the memory of victims of gun violence, like my daughter, by pushing for strong gun violence prevention measures in Congress.

Ever since I lost my daughter four years ago on Valentine’s Day, I’ve made it my mission to support and elect people like Jared — people who are committed to keeping our children safe, pushing back against government inaction and saving lives.

And today, I hope you’ll join me in that mission. If you can, please click here to chip in $25, or any amount, to help elect Jared Moskowitz as our next Congressman. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-march2022?refcode=311guttenberg]

body:
We need all hands on deck to hold on to Pennsylvania in 2022, and I’m ready to work hard with this team to make it happen.

Friends - it’s Josh Shapiro here, and I asked Gavin Newsom if I could reach out to you.
**I’m humbled and honored to officially be the Democratic nominee for Governor of Pennsylvania. The general election starts now —[will you join me and Gavin Newsom and donate $3 right now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-shapiro?refcode=em-220519-1-7&refcode2=829_4767699_tjuaCL&akid=829%2E4767699%2EtjuaCL)
I’m a Pennsylvanian. I was raised here, and my wife Lori and I are raising our four kids just a few miles down the road from where I grew up. I’ve spent my career serving the people of our Commonwealth as a State Representative, a County Commissioner, and now as the People’s Attorney General.
We need all hands on deck to hold on to Pennsylvania in 2022, and I’m ready to work hard with this team to make it happen.
The fact is, our GOP opponent wants to bring an extremist, conservative agenda to Pennsylvania — and I’m ready to take him on with everything I’ve got.
[**If you’re with me and Gavin Newsom in this fight to protect our democracy, defend our rights, and win our tough races — can you split $3 today between my campaign and Gavin Newsom?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-shapiro?refcode=em-220519-1-7&refcode2=829_4767699_tjuaCL&akid=829%2E4767699%2EtjuaCL)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-shapiro?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em-220519-1-7&refcode2=829_4767699_tjuaCL&akid=829%2E4767699%2EtjuaCL)
I’ve spent my career taking on the big and powerful, whether it was taking on well-connected corporate interests to protect health care for nearly two million Western Pennsylvanians, holding accountable predatory priests to get justice for survivors after decades of sexual abuse and cover-ups, or standing up to Trump’s election lies in the courtroom to protect our democracy.
As Pennsylvania’s Governor, I’ll keep taking on those big fights. I’ll fight to defend your right to vote, I’ll fight to defend access to abortion, and I’ll fight to defend our democracy — right here in the birthplace of our nation.
[**Can I count on you to join this important fight? Make a donation of any amount now to support my campaign for Governor and Gavin Newsom as we fight to win our races this November.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gcn-em-shapiro?refcode=em-220519-1-7&refcode2=829_4767699_tjuaCL&akid=829%2E4767699%2EtjuaCL)
This is going to be one hell of a fight — but with you, I know we can win it.
Thanks for joining this team,
Josh Shapiro
_Democratic nominee for Governor of Pennsylvania_

On May 3rd, I was the first candidate to call on the Department of Justice to "unequivocally declare they will investigate and prosecute any attempts by citizens, groups or elected officials to impact by threats or violence the outcome of any pending decision by the United States Supreme Court." These threats not are now continuing and are being fanned by the left. This is unacceptable to our system of checks and balances. If the opinion expressed holds, it would be a significant victory in the fight to protect the unborn and defend our Constitution. However, Planned Parenthood and every progressive candidate and committee are using this as an opportunity to raise and spend millions of dollars on promoting pro-choice legislation. **_It’s scary stuff. _** As a father of two and a lifelong Christian, being pro-life is deeply personal to me, and I know it is to you too. The sanctity of human life is crucial and fragile. **As your Congressman, you can count on me to always stand up and fight to protect our most vulnerable. **

It’s one of the reasons I joined the Marine Corps – to do something that mattered, beyond myself. Something that would help people. I served nine years in the Marine Corps, four overseas tours, and remain in the reserves – ready to help if I’m needed. When I got home, I became increasingly concerned about the direction our country was headed in and I knew I had to jump in and to help, so I hopped into a congressional race in a swing district with no resources, knowledge, or background in politics. I knew things would be tough, but as it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me – we didn’t need another self-serving politician in Washington! My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign, losing to a well-funded Democrat by just 2%. In case you were wondering why you may not have heard from me before now, it’s because I lost in 2020 by less than 11,000 votes in what became one of the closest congressional races in the 2020 election. I’m running to unseat the same Pelosi-approved Democrat once again – and like last time, she’s very well-funded. In fact, Just like last time, this race will be very close. That’s probably why both Dems and Republicans alike have labeled this as a top-targeted race. I’m never going to be the loudest conservative in the House – nor the most colorful – but I’ll put my head down and work diligently to get the work of the people done. Isn’t that worth something anymore? The Marines taught me to never give up and that everything is achievable if one works hard enough for it. Over the past two years I’ve laid in bed wondering what might have been if I had an adequately funded campaign. I’ll never know. I do know that I’m running against the same Democrat who beat me in 2020 and this race is likely going to be even closer than the one from two years ago. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today: I’d hate to get so close to victory again and run out of money just before Election Day. Today, I’m asking for your help – because I know that this mission will take a strong team, and that no man can win alone. In 2010, I took an oath to defend our nation and serve our country – and that oath will never expire. I’ve approached this campaign the same way I approach everything in life, through servant leadership. But every leader knows it is their team that makes them great, not themselves. , It's taken me a bit to process the tragedy that took place last weekend in Buffalo, New York, but I knew I wanted to share my thoughts with you. It's heartbreaking that still in America, Black people are going about their everyday lives, only to die at the hands of a white supremacist who targeted them because of their skin color. ** ** Substitute a grocery store in Buffalo with a church in Charleston and the parallels between the tragedies are striking. As I'm sure it did for many of you, hearing the news brought me straight back to that horrible June day in 2015. I was flooded with the fear, the frustration, and the worry that despite my best efforts, our lawmakers will do largely nothing to prevent the next act of targeted racial violence. ** ** Unfortunately, it looks like my concerns are justified: South Carolina Republicans just last week, minutes before the legislative session ended, blocked the passage of the Clementa C. Pinckney Hate Crimes Act. This legislation, named in honor of my former colleague and our late State Senator who was tragically murdered at the Mother Emanuel AME Church, would increase the criminal penalty for crimes motivated by hatred of a victim based on race, ethnicity, religion, or other unchangeable features. Legislative session after legislative session, I've fought tooth and nail for this bill. As hate crimes are on the rise, it was infuriating to see the Republicans block this bill again, making South Carolina one of just two states without a hate crimes law. ** ** How can Republicans continue to justify their unbridled hypocrisy? They refuse to pass the most basic common-sense gun reforms that would save lives. They refuse to pass a hate crimes law. They've shredded our social safety net, making it harder for South Carolina families to make ends meet. And they do all of this under the guise of being pro-life- now how does that make a lick of sense? ** ** In times like these, when the news is so gut-wrenching, I know it can be tempting to disengage from politics, but we can't fall into that trap. We have to do something. ** ** All McMaster and the GOP have to offer is empty thoughts and silent prayers, and I've had enough. South Carolinians need an advocate who will stand up for common-sense gun legislation and stand up against hate crimes- that's why I'm running against McMaster for Governor- because South Carolina deserves better. ** ** In solidarity, Mia

She is a former State Representative, current State Senator representing District 22, and is running as a Democratic candidate for Governor.

Peter –
Election Day is this Tuesday, and we need your support! | Team, my name is Lily, and I’m part of the communications team here at AZ Dems.

I’m writing to tell you about a new voter outreach tool to make sure we’re getting important messaging out to younger voters. Yes, what I’m saying is we’re now on TikTok!

body:
It’s time for San Franciscans to elect a person who truly represents us in Washington, someone who exemplifies our values. I’m proud to support Shahid, and invite you to do the same. | | |
---
| | Dear Peter, **** At a time Democrats in Congress need to reassert progressive priorities and defend hard found principals—such as a committment to universal health care including abortion rights, and human rights in the face of rising militarism & xenophobia—Shahid Buttar has emerged as the candidate that best exemplifies San Francisco values. His opponent, Nancy Pelosi, who never held elective office before winning the seat, has refused to debate any opponent in over 30 years in office. When her record is examined carefully, it’s apparent that she has not been aligned with our city’s core values for decades. As hard as it may be for some to believe, she has recently supported anti-choice candidates (against a progressive pro-choice candidate) and she has come under scrutiny for amassing wealth from insider trading opportunities. When confronted, she has failed to give an adequate explanation, which in turn has provided fodder for critics on the right to show the left’s hypocrisy. San Francisco deserves political voices who share our city’s values, not those who have built careers alleging support for them while undermining them in practice. When I served as President of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors, I came from outside the city’s political establishment and helped shift the political landscape at City Hall. That’s one reason I’m excited to endorse another voice from outside the establishment who will steer Congress in the progressive direction it desperately needs to move toward. Although the press and his opponent will not engage him, it is not because Shahid lacks talent or isn’t worthy of attention. He is a rare human being who would be an important part of the transformation that must take place in Congress if we are to make advances in our policy agenda, progress many of us have been waiting decades for. In my opinion, Shahid is among the very finest political candidates I have seen emerge in San Francisco in the over thirty years that I have been closely watching. San Francisco’s representative in Congress should be an exciting voice for new ideas and someone who stands up to the corrupt values so many congresspersons are aligned with. I know Shahid would make our city proud. For twenty years, he’s worked both across the Bay Area and across the entire country to challenge the militarism and domestic surveillance in which Pelosi has long been complicit. That’s the kind of track record I want from a candidate. In 2020, Shahid won more votes against Pelosi than any challenger she has ever faced, obtaining over 80,000 votes, despite being outspent 15 to 1. With greater exposure, I know San Franciscans will see the same traits and potential I see in his candidacy. **It’s time for San Franciscans to elect a person who truly represents us in Washington, someone who exemplifies our values. I’m proud to[support Shahid](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJRa3BuD5dTQdo420pYxm_dRT81C-ERvdBti0izUUMSCj5oao5KF9Gv6__I9GRsLX4CE4Y65pLo9P2M_srAsYPA7Z4ze4FJo8aVtuY9kPJ8W2LMmsjl1B31dFEydoGQB817cpAm5bpuSA4orS-hJ2Xq8feq1VL7p6HzP006cvQ5MI8mci3S5wtsF_1_Oj4zar70Boo57dIF4x6zxYJYkElQ0P4hT-AUpRBe92aunX2KC0mtaZXCE-Ck87yQ8eKQKLpjM4uud2dKXqsycnAqpq_VK8rbrnd237zJ6sV3N9YDygKic1REB1x7YdQpZubIN4Q/3m6/dJzHNrStT2ieotybCk6Hrw/h0/OpYHlcTMPBkSHiBBUHJIHSP1ANe8ffVOJvJKxC15qZE), and invite you to do the same. ** Sincerely,
Matt Gonzalez Chief Attorney, San Francisco Public Defender's Office
Former President, San Francisco Board of Supervisors, 2003
Green Party Vice Presidential nominee, 2008

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Justice Democrat Summer Lee won her primary against the political
establishment on Tuesday night in PA-12! It’s a huge victory and our
second primary win of the year. Now, I want to tell you what this means
for our movement.

It was hard to start this work and it’s been hard to sustain it. But what
keeps us going is your support and our major upset victories. After
Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign, a bunch of us got together and
decided to work towards electing progressives that shared Bernie’s vision
to the U.S. House. If we changed politics in Congress, we could deliver
important wins for the people.

Our first major win came after we recruited Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to
run for Congress in NY-14 against one of the most powerful Democrats in
the House. We were outspent but our message, our strategy, and our
organizing won.

We wondered if we could replicate what we did and elect more progressives
in 2020, while also ensuring the Squad was re-elected. We recruited and
helped elect Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, and re-elected every member of
the Squad.

But could we keep this work up? Fundraising is always difficult,
especially when we’re 100% grassroots funded going up against the
unlimited corporate money of the political establishment.

Even with a budget a fraction of the size of most other political
organizations, we kept going. And we’ve kept winning. We won a primary
backing Greg Casar in TX-35 earlier this year. And Tuesday night, we stood
with our 2022 recruit as she declared victory in Pittsburgh. Summer Lee
overcame millions in Super PAC spending to win the Democratic nomination
for PA-12.

The mission of Justice Democrats is to recruit and run progressive
candidates often from working-class backgrounds. Candidates from these
backgrounds have fewer resources to hire expensive staff who can get their
campaigns going. JD helps fill some of those gaps. And with Summer, our
team of staff and volunteers helped Summer strategize, organize, and
out-campaign the corporate lawyer and corporate Super PACs in this race.

It’s amazing what we can do as a movement working together against
millions of dollars spent attacking us — millions of dollars from Wall
Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma, health insurance CEOs, and union busters. We
do it with donations of $5, $27, and $100 at a time from regular people
who want to see Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and student debt
cancellation in our country.

We have another primary on Tuesday, when Jessica Cisneros takes on the
only anti-abortion Democrat in the House, Henry Cuellar. Cuellar is a
conservative Democrat who consistently votes against abortion rights,
labor rights, and action to address climate change. Yet, he still has the
backing of Nancy Pelosi and high-ranking Democrats in the House.

It’s another race where we’re up against corporate Super PACs and the
Democratic establishment, and we need your help to make sure Jessica
defeats Cuellar.

Peter, can you
step up today and help Justice Democrats win more primaries against
corporate Democrats?

I know we can do amazing things together, because we’ve done amazing

clean_body: [1]Justice Democrats Peter, Justice Democrat Summer Lee won her primary against the political establishment on Tuesday night in PA-12! It’s a huge victory and our second primary win of the year. Now, I want to tell you what this means for our movement. It was hard to start this work and it’s been hard to sustain it. But what keeps us going is your support and our major upset victories. After Bernie’s 2016 presidential campaign, a bunch of us got together and decided to work towards electing progressives that shared Bernie’s vision to the U.S. House. If we changed politics in Congress, we could deliver important wins for the people. Our first major win came after we recruited Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to run for Congress in NY-14 against one of the most powerful Democrats in the House. We were outspent but our message, our strategy, and our organizing won. We wondered if we could replicate what we did and elect more progressives in 2020, while also ensuring the Squad was re-elected. We recruited and helped elect Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, and re-elected every member of the Squad. But could we keep this work up? Fundraising is always difficult, especially when we’re 100% grassroots funded going up against the unlimited corporate money of the political establishment. Even with a budget a fraction of the size of most other political organizations, we kept going. And we’ve kept winning. We won a primary backing Greg Casar in TX-35 earlier this year. And Tuesday night, we stood with our 2022 recruit as she declared victory in Pittsburgh. Summer Lee overcame millions in Super PAC spending to win the Democratic nomination for PA-12. The mission of Justice Democrats is to recruit and run progressive candidates often from working-class backgrounds. Candidates from these backgrounds have fewer resources to hire expensive staff who can get their campaigns going. JD helps fill some of those gaps. And with Summer, our team of staff and volunteers helped Summer strategize, organize, and out-campaign the corporate lawyer and corporate Super PACs in this race. It’s amazing what we can do as a movement working together against millions of dollars spent attacking us — millions of dollars from Wall Street, Big Oil, Big Pharma, health insurance CEOs, and union busters. We do it with donations of $5, $27, and $100 at a time from regular people who want to see Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and student debt cancellation in our country. We have another primary on Tuesday, when Jessica Cisneros takes on the only anti-abortion Democrat in the House, Henry Cuellar. Cuellar is a conservative Democrat who consistently votes against abortion rights, labor rights, and action to address climate change. Yet, he still has the backing of Nancy Pelosi and high-ranking Democrats in the House. It’s another race where we’re up against corporate Super PACs and the Democratic establishment, and we need your help to make sure Jessica defeats Cuellar. Peter, can you step up today and help Justice Democrats win more primaries against corporate Democrats? Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 4 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $15,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**
[**Please, may I count on you to make a donation to my campaign today – before our fundraising deadline? body:
Garrett can bring the people's voice back into politics | | | Peter, My name is Joe Bandlow, Midland County Captain with Garrett Soldano for Governor - "We the People's" Campaign.

_Garrett has shown us what true leadership looks like again at a political level._

Before Garrett, I despised politics. I viewed every politician as in it for themselves and felt that the government working for the people was lost in America.

I served proudly in the US Navy, and when I returned home, that pride I once had for my country slowly faded away, and was replaced by years of mistrust for our political leaders. All politicians say they work for the people, but you can usually see right through their words, and our mistrust is usually proven correct.

_I would not give my endorsement, and full support to Garrett if I thought he was just another politician._

He is a business owner and a family man who got into politics when regular citizens like us needed a leader to stand up to Governor Whitmer's unconstitutional lockdown orders. When the politicians and insiders sat on the sidelines, Garrett was fighting for our freedoms, our businesses, and for our kids.

He has inspired so many people in Michigan to take a stand. To take our state and our country back, we must work to elect patriotic citizens like Garrett Soldano to be a 'statesman' - not just another career politician.

Garrett is someone who can bring the peoples voice back into politics. _His character, commitment, and conservative values are what will make him a great Governor and are why my vote is going to Mr. Soldano in the Republican Primary on August 2nd!_

\- _Joe Bandlow_

**P.S.**_-_ Unlike other candidates, Garrett isn't relying on special interests to fund his campaign. He's not a millionaire either, so he can't just spend all of his own money to buy votes. _That's why I donate $50 a month as a Card-Carrying Eagle Member of his campaign._

Dear Friend,

We needed a day to process the election results.

While Dr. Oz is in the lead for Republican senatorial candidate, terrifyingly, Jan. 6 insurrectionist and state Sen. Doug Mastriano won the Republican nomination for governor.
If Mastriano wins, he will single-handedly be able to tear down our democratic voting process in PA.

- He has not only tirelessly worked to overturn the fair 2020 presidential election results, he has vowed to decertify voting machines in counties he thinks were rigged, pointlessly costing taxpayers.

- He would also let the Republican-led legislature decide which presidential electors to send to D.C. It will be chaos if he wins.

People who tried to overthrow our government should not be allowed to run it! Stand with us today by donating to help us hit the streets to protect our democracy. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=051922]

Thank you for your time!

Fellow Conservative,

Like so many Americans, I watched the scenes of Afghanistan's fall with disbelief, extreme sadness and even anger. You see, I served the greatest country on Earth in Afghanistan back in 2015. But Afghanistan wasn't the only place I looked terrorism directly in the eyes...

**August 21 st 2021 marked six years since the fateful late-summer afternoon that changed my life and those of my two best friends - forever.**

**I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when my best friends and I decided to take a vacation in Europe**. We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all.

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat -As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. **Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.**

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Fellow Conservative - **I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.**

[**At the end of this email, I am going to ask you to donate $6 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the sixth anniversary of the Thalys train attack. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Jessica Cisneros
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I don’t make the decision to endorse an opponent to a colleague in my caucus lightly. But the future of reproductive rights is at stake, and I simply cannot stand by when there is a strong pro-choice, pro-worker Democrat ready to step in.
#
Peter,
At a time when our reproductive freedoms are under attack by an extremist Supreme Court, we must elect pro-choice candidates that will fight to make sure abortion remains the law of the land.
I don’t make the decision to endorse an opponent to a colleague in my caucus lightly. But the future of reproductive rights is at stake, and I simply cannot stand by when there is a strong pro-choice, pro-worker Democrat ready to step in.
**Jessica Cisneros will be a force for choice and progressive change — and today, I am proud to endorse her for Congress.**
**Jessica’s runoff election is in just five days, and early voting has already begun. She needs all hands on deck to power her campaign to victory.[Peter, will you split a $3 contribution between our campaigns right now to help Jessica reach more voters across Texas’ 28th District?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13872?refcode=em20220519-1279&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=1279%2E420207%2ELIYQEG)**
**[Contribute $3 »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13872?refcode=em20220519-1279&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=1279%2E420207%2ELIYQEG)**
Jessica Cisneros is an activist, advocate, and immigration lawyer who has spent her entire life advocating for the people of South Texas — _the very kind of people-first leader we need more of in Congress._
She is bold, fearless, and unafraid to fight for people’s basic freedoms — whether it’s to protect workers’ rights, enact climate action, or preserve people’s right to choose. **I know she will stand side by side with us to make sure that working families, especially Black and Brown communities, have a voice.**
But with a surge of special interests spending against Jessica, it’s critical that her campaign has the resources to reach more voters as they make up their minds on which candidate to support. [**Please split a $3 contribution between our campaigns today, and let’s help Jessica win this runoff!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/13872?refcode=em20220519-1279&%3Bamounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=1279%2E420207%2ELIYQEG)
In solidarity,
Pramila

Hi there - my name is Ross Purgason and I'm the campaign manager for Republican Alek Skarlatos, the Republican nominee for U.S. House in Oregon's 4th Congressional District. **I'm fowarding you an email he sent several months back in hopes you might have time to read it today**.

Thank you for your time!

Peter,

Like so many Americans, I watched the scenes of Afghanistan's fall with disbelief, extreme sadness and even anger. You see, I served the greatest country on Earth in Afghanistan back in 2015. But Afghanistan wasn't the only place I looked terrorism directly in the eyes...

**August 21 st 2021 marked six years since the fateful late-summer afternoon that changed my life and those of my two best friends - forever.**

**I had just finished serving our great nation in Afghanistan when my best friends and I decided to take a vacation in Europe**. We were traveling on a Paris-bound train when a terrorist emerged from the bathroom, bare-chested and armed with an assault rifle, a jar of gasoline, and 270 rounds of ammunition attempted to take over and kill us all.

As a soldier, I was trained to take out a terrorist threat -As an American, I was taught to stand up for freedom no matter where I was in the world. **Which is why I, my friends and other brave travelers took the action needed to stop this terrorist.**

This split-second decision prevented what witnesses contend could have become a mass slaughter. There is a reason I was able to make this split-second decision to intervene, Peter - **I have and always will be willing to give my life in the fight for freedom, in the image of true American values.**

[**At the end of this email, I am going to ask you to donate $6 to my campaign for Congress, in honor of the sixth anniversary of the Thalys train attack. But first, you need to understand why we need an American fighter like myself in Washington.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=51d325adb99d46999f6d053abe893888&_e=esKbAnITHfIIkzX4deByHfnHbcjlBD_2qtRAXYMW5A0xrtjt1gYD6byANdsmuxRgqzDzusoLgsfqXWMZjrxPDbfrq0FYhmtg5SDUHMJBQh9atHufnYxA_iVrvKXc63Is2WxHNdvUvgfNZax2yioU9bddsc9dhyPxdzx_9-m65MFX4wx1VtBNuDG12Cn-sZWAIgxkXnhbzpQktSpKpB_ZUAPZ41K0fZ-skieZleDgJRmfnoD7HJybfCdZOqND8JXS8ueO_abX_vX1EBZgEoAwWAPjCgu7QHjMVV5SEPolPNXhBQrpxtI5DCpDyxnAYNkmY0BaLjMeym7KIIXyA_Aw6cZEews1nKl2t4rqRvuy9-7uimZTxojEgUx-NVYJeSrPK0Qm6713ndocYwhmH-agIq4ZhK8YYFv23MOvPyO1pEpVR5dvpvtu0KWLaK9UKs1BtUHdWJHVlYbhEnhfNZlcnOPMAtCzxcjUx86tXpClcf8%3D)

Now, our homeland is in danger. Not from radical Islamic terrorists, but radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. Leftist legislation is assaulting our Nation, our communities, and the American Dream.

Right now, Democrats are...
* Opening and destroying our borders. They are g**ranting dangerous amnesty** that will flood every corner of America.
* **Raising our taxes** like we have never seen, and making common goods like gas and groceries unaffordable.
* **Defunding the police,** leading to a surge in violent crime
* **Erasing historical figures** from our schools like George Washington and Abraham Lincoln
* Teetering on the edge of a **dangerous foreign policy crisis**

These power-hungry Democrat elitists like Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden don’t care about the people they represent. **They only care about their own radical agenda.**

The Biden Democrats' grip on power in Washington is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security. The only way to pull America out of this leftist tailspin is by taking back the House in 2022. **We need a fighter in Congress, Peter and I hope that hearing my story proves to you that I am the man for the job.**

My life’s mission has always been to represent the America I know and love - the world’s bastion of freedom and economic prosperity. [**I am taking that mission and putting it into action by running for Congress, by fighting for my neighbors and their wellbeing in Washington.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=51d325adb99d46999f6d053abe893888&_e=esKbAnITHfIIkzX4deByHfnHbcjlBD_2qtRAXYMW5A0xrtjt1gYD6byANdsmuxRgqzDzusoLgsfqXWMZjrxPDbfrq0FYhmtg5SDUHMJBQh9atHufnYxA_iVrvKXc63Is2WxHNdvUvgfNZax2yioU9bddsc9dhyPxdzx_9-m65MFX4wx1VtBNuDG12Cn-sZWAIgxkXnhbzpQktSpKpB_ZUAPZ41K0fZ-skieZleDgJRmfnoD7HJybfCdZOqND8JXSwKDu6jZBxdoJM0Ta1j5JSTJI1WaeP4bC9s29r41tqikfIlSRnagiQiY5j2A1TvoYle2jaB3x7OVnQ5bvMxZwcb-ltj8WvIWOmZnUErwA9AwTZ74liQ31gNhgM6EV2faUNth6BRmAPgYqKs152lVFOVhx8fgWzUx2uqFUxT5_WhWSWRPtLtZ7AlABxKNK5toq8EQtYlOgeRbrJz1HbOhuCtwriQrIpWtKniwnUx2xZMs%3D)

## Top Supporters of AG Rob Bonta, DA George Gascon, and DA Chesa Boudin Engage in “Political Dirty Tricks” and Spend Over $1 Million to Support Weakest AG Candidate, Causing Republican Outrage
---
|
San Francisco -- Some of the top donors and supporters of California Attorney General Rob Bonta and two of the state's most progressive district attorneys, George Gascon of Los Angeles and Chesa Boudin of San Francisco, both of whom are facing recalls, have spent over $1 million on political ads on conservative media to bolster the campaign of the weakest candidate for attorney general in an attempt to avoid a general election against the leading Republican challenger, Nathan Hochman.

The PACs, Communities for Justice and Californians Supporting Rob Bonta for Attorney General 2022, are seeking to elevate Eric Early's support among Republican voters by airing ads statewide on conservative talk radio stations and FOX NEWS, saying things such as Early is a "Trump Republican", despite a lack of endorsement by former President Trump or the California Republican Party.

Republican House Leader Kevin McCarthy and the California Republican Party have endorsed Nathan Hochman.

The San Francisco Chronicle published an article on May 10 headlined [Why backers of Democratic Attorney General Rob Bonta are trying to help the most anti-abortion candidate in the race.](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=78602230a3&e=94837ebab3)

"So pro-Bonta forces are playing some three-dimensional political chess," the Chronicle's Joe Garofoli wrote. "Their goal in pitching these message to conservative talk show audience listeners is that they hope those voters question whether Schubert or Hochman are conservative enough to taken on the left-leaning Bonta. If enough back Early, then Bonta gets his preferred opponent."

SFGATE published an article on May 11 headlined [Very cynical ads back Gavin Newsom, Rod Bonta in California primary](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=71295e98a9&e=94837ebab3).

"The release of two new campaign ads in the past week strongly suggests California Gov. Gavin Newsom and supporters of Attorney General Rob Bonta are attempting to handpick certain Republican challengers as their general election opponents — picks that would all but guarantee victories by the two incumbents in November," SFGATE's Alec Regimbal wrote. "The group believes Bonta could easily beat Early. In their minds, a primary victory by a different candidate — such as independent Anne Marie Schubert or Nathan Hochman, a Republican endorsed by California’s state GOP — could result in a more bruising general campaign."

The [deceptive political manipulation](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=36245d138d&e=94837ebab3) has caused outrage among California's Republican leaders.

"It's incredibly telling that California Democrats are so worried about their unqualified, appointed attorney general Rob Bonta facing Nathan Hochman in the general election that they are going to such great lengths to deceive voters," said California's RNC National Committeewoman, Harmeet K. Dhillon. "While the Democrats claim to fight against 'disinformation', they are in fact the largest purveyors of it here in California."

The California Republican Party broadly sent out an email about the deception on Saturday with the subject line: Dem Attorney General Misinformation Campaign. [Click here to view the letter.](https://strategyinsightshq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=634ddc357d96a36fb118fa25c&id=9137c2ffea&e=94837ebab3)

Early is a perennial candidate that ran for attorney general in 2018 and earned last place in the primary election. Then again in 2020, Early ran against Congressman Adam Schiff and lost by 45%.

Hochman has served as an Assistant US Attorney for the Central District of California and as a US Assistant Attorney General for the US Department of Justice. Hochman has also worked as a civil litigator, defense and appellate attorney, and general counsel, and clerked for a US District Court Judge. His years of community involvement include membership on numerous charitable boards and serving as President of the Los Angeles City Ethics Commission.

body:
Thank you for a wonderful experience | | | | [ ](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=b9d15ed499&e=1090c5c412)
---
|
---
| | | **A Letter to My Supporters**
Dear Friends,

I just got off the phone with Lisa Scheller. I congratulated her on her victory and wished her well in the general election. We all want to reverse the damaging progressive policies that are hurting our nation. I truly hope that Lisa Scheller’s campaign will contribute to a Republican wave that returns fiscal responsibility and limited government to Washington. We need it.

Don’t be discouraged.

I had three goals in this campaign, and from time to time, I’ve communicated each of them to you.

First, I wanted to defeat Susan Wild and restore a Republican Majority in Congress. That goal remains in reach for Republicans this November.

Second, I wanted to prove that a normal guy, who’s not rich, famous, or a professional politician, can represent his neighbors in Washington. We didn’t win, but we competed in the big leagues. And in the places where people know me personally, we won in a landslide.

My campaign was outraised 10:1 and opposed by the Republican establishment. We still came within a few votes of winning this election. I hope future candidates, those who fit the profile of ordinary people who’ve lived extraordinary lives, will study this race, and be inspired to run for office. It can be done successfully.

Finally, I wanted to represent my faith, family, and country with dignity and honor, as a true Christian Statesman. The great British author C. S. Lewis described such a person as one who devotes his whole effort in the public square to “putting ‘Do as you would be done by’ into action.”

I’ve tried to do this every day, and I hope it showed. I never compromised my principles, never embarrassed my family name, and never exhibited conduct unbecoming an officer. Only my Lord Jesus Christ will judge whether I achieved this goal, but today I am at peace with my work.

I want to thank all the people who helped me throughout this journey. My wife Susan, Will, Jake and Eli, mom and dad, and my entire family. Old friends and new ones. Familiar faces and strangers. That gentle old man from Monroe County who sent my campaign a check for $5. My hands were trembling when I took it out of the envelope.

The sportsman’s clubs were incredibly supportive. So were the veterans, police officers, and first responders. I was especially excited by the engagement of so many young people in our campaign. You give me hope!

The pro-life community is amazing. We have a new chance to protect all human life, especially unborn children. Thank you for your commitment to the weak and the vulnerable.

Hundreds of people spent thousands of hours making calls, knocking on doors, and working the polls. My campaign managers and field coordinators were all volunteers. I genuinely appreciate your donations of time, talents, and resources. And of course, your prayers.

Humbling is the best word to describe this experience. I’ve enjoyed the ride, and I hope you did too. Let’s make it a priority to maintain and grow all these friendships we’ve made. That’s an enduring treasure from this race that I never expected but value most of all.

One of my favorite Bible verses is Matthew 10:29-31. Jesus said, “Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground outside your Father’s care. And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So don’t be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.”

Don’t be afraid.

We don’t know why God does things and we cannot conceive of His plans. But He has plans for us, nonetheless. And He is always in charge, guiding humanity towards the Kingdom of God.

I wanted to win this race. Very badly. And I know you did too. But I accept the outcome.

Now let’s use our campaign as a springboard for optimism, authenticity, and civility in our politics going forward. Let’s continue to hold our party leaders and elected officials accountable. And let’s take every opportunity to share our faith, defend the Constitution, and advance our conservative values.

I’m not going anywhere. I don’t need to be in Washington to keep working for Safe Communities, Good Jobs, and Strong Families. I’m happy to do it from my front porch in Germansville too. With Huck by my side. And maybe an occasional whiskey and cigar too.

Whatever happens next, please know one thing. I’ll keep fighting to Keep America Free!

Thank you, friends, and God Bless.
